# Raw zero-input covariant reference bridges

An independently authored raw Producer<R> implementation returns a narrower
closed Value or java.lang.Void. Compiler-generated Object forwarding bridges
retain the raw class header and original typed body. Frozen typed, compiled
raw-interface, reflection and MethodHandle calls verify opaque return identity,
partial static mutations and exact class-init/body failures across two attempts.
Source/SDK API and result declarations run for both result classes. All emitted
Java, original entries, metadata and Exceptions are checked. Independently
compiled wrong programs alter call/store/result timing and opaque results.
No null-only or nonreturning target-body assumption is made.
